title: Lean: arbitrarily strong descents in the forced dyadic section
body:
## Goal and result

PR #173 proves that every positive ordinary orbit reaches its narrowing dyadic section. This PR builds on that result to attack the missing marked-return descent. **Full Collatz remains open.** The new positive theorem gives arbitrarily strong actual marked-return contractions on unbounded families, including an unconditional family with no convergence premise.

This PR is stacked on PR #173 at `fa0c9e2a2851e6324391e39c17afcb5913185aec`. Its original proof files are unchanged.

## Main new theorem — unconditional arbitrary contractions

For every natural contraction factor C and size threshold N, Lean proves that there exist d, y and k with

```text
n = 2^d + 1 > N
Marked n
Marked y
0 < k
returns n k = y
y < n
C*y < n
Basin n ↔ Basin y
```

The exact declaration is `power_plus_one_arbitrarily_strong`. It concerns an actual later iterate of the first-positive-return map, not necessarily the first return. It does not assert convergence of n or y.

The general theorem supplies the same result for every fixed odd offset r with a supplied finite certificate that r reaches one. Exact high-bit transport and terminal-cycle padding give

`T^(h+2s)(2^(h+2s+1)+r) = 2*3^(p+s)+1`.

A new modular-inverse argument selects arbitrarily large q with
`0 < q*log₂3-a < 2/q`. Both endpoints are then proved marked, and integer coefficient estimates give any requested contraction factor. No continued-fraction hypothesis or random-parity assumption is used.

[Full argument and scope](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8372e302041a55057742a9e6ee9b4fa600c88fdb/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/README.md) · [Infinite-family Lean proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8372e302041a55057742a9e6ee9b4fa600c88fdb/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/InfiniteDescent.lean)

## Other new results

- **Exact offset certificates:** a sound and complete finite evaluator for actual strict descent of an ordinary affine lift. Its necessary and sufficient positive-quotient threshold retains the additive correction.
- **Concrete marked-return coverage:** three kernel-checked integer certificates cover every `2^d+1` with `3 <= d <= 1,603,754`. These are symbolic exponent windows, not enumerations of gigantic starting values.
- **Global phase constraint:** every fixed unbounded ordinary odd trajectory has vanishing nonzero Fourier means of its binary logarithmic phases, without a growth-rate or summability hypothesis.
- **Low-bit constraint:** with `L(x)=1+[x≡1 mod4]+[x≡5 mod8]`, every escaping odd trajectory has average L eventually at most `log₂3+epsilon`. Lean therefore excludes escape if that average tends to `7/4`. Leading-phase cancellation does not prove this low-bit average.
- Exact integer certificate search, a pinned sequential replay script, source hashes, and independent mathematical reviews.

## Remaining closing step

The full criterion still requires eventual marked-return descent for **every prescribed marked source**. The new infinite theorem fixes a certified offset and then selects suitable exponents. It neither covers every marked pair (d,r), nor transfers a hypothetical failure from its prescribed exponent to a selected lift. The analytic lane likewise lacks the necessary leading-phase/low-bit relation and does not exclude nontrivial bounded cycles.

## Actual verification

- Fresh sequential Lean 4.34.1 build of all **7** proof files: **PASS**, with `-j1 -DwarningAsError=true`.
- The 3 imported modules match the exact PR #173 source hashes; all 7 source hashes stayed stable throughout execution and match this published commit.
- **28** printed principal axiom closures audited, including **23** new declarations: only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. No `sorryAx`, custom convergence axiom, or native reduction trust shortcut.
- Independent review reconstructed the offset thresholds, marked guards, clocks, one-sided approximation, infinite-family quantifiers, phase proof and low-bit restriction.
- Clean, complete checkout of this exact final published commit: **5/5 repository validation commands passed**, with 340 tracked files and unchanged commit/tree/content. Optional historical regressions were not rerun. Repository integrity is separate from mathematical proof checking.

[Build receipts and reviews](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8372e302041a55057742a9e6ee9b4fa600c88fdb/reports/2026-11-21-dyadic-descent/README.md) · [Exact Lean execution receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8372e302041a55057742a9e6ee9b4fa600c88fdb/reports/2026-11-21-dyadic-descent/LEAN_RECEIPT.json) · [Axiom audit](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8372e302041a55057742a9e6ee9b4fa600c88fdb/reports/2026-11-21-dyadic-descent/AXIOM_AUDIT.json)
